resources.string: A menu in the header bar with which every user chooses the language of Admidio for themselves.
Show the flag of each language instead of the translation icon. A language is not a country: English shows the British flag, Portuguese and Brazilian Portuguese their own flags.
The languages the menu offers. None selected: all languages of Admidio.
Keep the chosen language in a cookie for the next visit.
Show the menu to visitors who are not logged in, too.
